reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Dr. Gallegos enough! She has been there for both my personal pets and the animals in our shelter, and we are incredibly grateful for her compassion, dedication, and willingness to go above and beyond.

From providing prompt care when my own pup was having an allergy attack, to thinking outside the box to find affordable treatment options when other clinics either couldn’t help or quoted prices far beyond what the average pet owner could afford, Dr. Gallegos has repeatedly shown that her priority is helping animals get the care they need. She has even helped provide urgent euthanasia services at an affordable price when it was needed most.

What truly sets her apart is that she understands not everyone has unlimited financial resources, and she doesn’t believe that should automatically mean an animal goes without care. She meets people where they are, works to find solutions, and offers payment assistance options to help make veterinary care more accessible. That kind of compassion makes an enormous difference, not only for the animals, but also for the people who love them and are doing their best for them.

As someone who works in animal welfare and has experienced her kindness firsthand as a pet owner, I can confidently say that veterinarians like Dr. Gallegos are an absolute gift to our community. We need more people in veterinary medicine who care this deeply about both animals and the people responsible for them.

We absolutely love Dr. Gallegos and are so thankful to have her as a resource for our personal pets and shelter animals. If you’re looking for a veterinarian who leads with compassion, thinks creatively, and genuinely wants to help, I wholeheartedly recommend her!

honestly not happy about the experience with East End Animal. I brought my dog in needing urgent care due to an issue with her breathing. After reviewing Xray's and bloodwork, the Vet determined that she had a pyometra and needed to remove it. After paying the $1,464 for the surgery, it was determined by the vet that it was in fact NOT a pyometra. They refunded me $194.. but reassured me that if I had any concerns (since it was not the issue) to bring her back free of charge. 5 days post surgery and she is still in labored breathing. We called to verify if we could bring her back and see what's wrong, whether its a complication from surgery or in fact the original issue that they misdiagnosed, and was told that the visit would be comped, but we would still be charged for any diagnostics or testing to determine. I feel like paying triple what a common spay (because that's what we got) should prompt a vet to want to do the right thing and actually figure out what's wrong with my dog since they were the ones who misdiagnosed and charged me for the wrong procedure.

If I could leave less stars I would! Explain to me why you are open until midnight if two nights in a row late at night yall can’t accept more animals! I work 11am to 11pm. Last night showed up right after 11pm and was declined due to “capacity” tonight tried calling before 11pm and again they are not accepting anymore visits! Put your hours to close earlier if yall don’t accept after 10pm! I’ve worked er and urgent care before and never could we say “oh sorry we are full” anyone that walks through the doors is seen! Just sad.

I absolutely love having an urgent care vet on this side of town. Dr. Gallegos and the entire team are fantastic. I’ve brought both of my dogs here for a variety of issues, including stitches, bladder infections, and skin problems. Every visit has been a positive experience. We always leave with a clear treatment plan, never feel pressured into unnecessary services, and have found the pricing to be fair and transparent.

I brought my mom’s cat who was bitten by a stray dog and this pet hospital saved his life and helped him right away. The wait time for a walk in was very minimal and they provided much needed pain medications for his recovery. The only suggestion I’d make is for the front desk staff to communicate better. One of the girls there clearly doesn’t want to be there and acts annoyed (eye rolling, attitude) when we asked questions as she explained very little. The other girl was friendly though. I still gave 5 stars for the veterinarian but I personally would let the unprofessional girl go. Just my opinion. Thanks for your help!! I would recommend :)
If you want to see your pets dead, go here, they’ll misdiagnose and mistreat them

I needed my car euthanized after a tragic accident and they were able to accommodate me as a walk in,  late on a Saturday evening. The front desk young lady is very sweet and has a great personality for the front desk. The techs were all very nice and informative and helpful.  The process was all very smooth and efficient.
They put my cat in a box for me to carry home to bury in my yard.   The cost was the cheapest around,  and I called many facilities in the Houston area.

This weekend was incredibly long and stressful, but everything worked out in the end, and I am so grateful. My dog got really sick with something called Pyometra, which turned out to be a life-threatening uterine infection. The first clinic we rushed her to couldn't do much because she needed immediate, emergency surgery. To make things worse, every emergency vet we called quoted prices that were just way too expensive. I was starting to panic, but we finally called East End Surgery Pet Clinic. They were able to take her in right away, and their rates were actually affordable. Plus, they set us up with a great financial plan that made it manageable. It was an incredibly scary few days, but she got the surgery she needed, and she is safe now.
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We truly appreciate your support and your trust in our clinic.
Everyone was so helpful and kind. They really tried to help our extremely sick cat, but it turned out to not be possible. The whole staff was so caring, thoughtful, and sympathetic.
Saved my dog’s life!!

They did emergency surgery on my cat Ayla I’ve had four+ years, saved my baby. They told me come in no later than 10:30pm- came at 10:10pm. Took her in for surgery and overnight stay 12/1am. We left at 11amish. It was quick and she was monitored before they left her at the clinic overnight. Gave meds and a cone super reasonable pricing considering the surgery. Thank you guys so much!! 😊🙏

Update: She healed well! 💗

East End cinic have a great service,very professional n undrerstending to your pet needs ,I will continue trusting my petscare to them n Natalya is extremely helpful with all details Thanks to crew for caring for my fur baby

It was a great experience didn't take long would have been 5 star but lost a star because it would have been nice to have a conversation with the vet which we never saw and had received a more clear diagnosis of what happen to our Becky. Also haven't received x-rays that i was promise I shoukd receive them at nught the same day,so I coukd follow up with our vet. All in all staff is super friendly. Would like to state it was a lil hot in the waiting area and lots of dirt at the entrance and hair in the room. Now I know hair ok but at your main door entrance it looks like it hasn't been cleaned in a long time and just makes one wonder if you entrance is like that how is your working environment where the animals are treated. Not trying to insult the business but it's just my honest review. Even with all this I would still go back in case of an emergency.
They were there in an urgent time of need. Our beloved family pet came through and is doing great. Communication with them is a bit rough, but have them some grace considering the hours they work.

Everyone was extremely nice and the care was very affordable. They were very sweet to my Lily, a pit mix I had just found on the streets. Some people are rude to strays, or pits, so I was very thankful for my experience with them. This is definitely going to be Lily's vet from now on 💖

I was waited on almost immediately. My dog was taken into the examination room and within 20mis or so, we had a diagnosis. The price was a bit high I thought but my Bear is doing much better as a result.

Came in because my dog had trouble opening his eye. The doctor diganosed him with an eye ulcer after performing a stain.
Timely service, explained everything they were doing and explained how to provide the care I needed to perform for my dog got better.
Paid $177 for the exam fee ($75), eye stain ($67), and medication ointment ($35).

The clinic defintely upcharged for the ointment as I can find it online for about $11 but considering my dog needed it ASAP, it's a cost I am personally okay with dealing with.

I would say if your pet is having an emergency, or if you struggle to find time during the week to take you pet to a vet, it's a solid place with high quality care.

Brought my dog for emergency stitches on paw. They had great proce so I add other treatments and vaccines and the cost was still great. They did a great job on her paw and other issues that she as like her anal glands.
I would highly recommend East End Animal and Urgent care for all your vet needs
They have helped our family twice and every one is as sweet as can be. No upselling. They truly care about you and your family.

Taking your family pet can be a nervous situation but the kind hearted staff welcomes you with a smile, concern and keeps you informed of everything. Prices are affordable and they hsve payment plan options if needed.

Unfortunately had to run all over town on a holiday and weekend. Six hour later and our third stop was here. There was a short wait, they were friendly, and got him in and prepped for surgery pretty fast. Our dog had two kidney stones that they removed, handled his recovery nicely and answered any questions we had. They also called us periodically to keep us updated with his progress.

Actually an amazing facility, amazing staff, amazing work. I cannot stress enough just how great this place is. Extremely knowledgeable, emphatic, affordable, and the list goes on. If you are in need of emergency service for your pet, this is the place to go.

My 9-year-old Staffy, Moto, was critically ill and in desperate need of emergency intestinal surgery to remove a blockage. He had become severely dehydrated and his electrolytes were dangerously abnormal from not eating. I was referred to this clinic after being quoted nearly $9,000 elsewhere, and had already spent $4k in diagnostics - their affordability truly gave me hope that I could save my sweet boy's life. The Dr was incredibly informative and compassionate, taking the time to explain everything clearly and set realistic expectations. She personally called me immediately after surgery to explain what she found and how he was doing. I will always be grateful to this clinic and their amazing staff for giving Moto a second chance. Their skill, kindness, and genuine care meant the world to my family, and I can't thank them enough for everything they did. 💙💙
I go to check my frenchie that was bad and They Give him medicine and They over drugh him we Need to take him to emergency after the medicine and now he’s dead

First of all, we never saw the vet, we only saw assistants, the first techs were super nice, then when they said it was going to be “2k” and we weren’t making a decision a rude tech came in and kinda push us to do it, but told us they were going to be closed on Monday and we would have to transfer my cat somewhere else so we asked where, and she was so rude pretty much like I had to figure it out. So they wanted me to pay $2k for a treatment that wasn’t going to be completely done and go somewhere else to pay more $$$ just bc they were closed but weren’t giving me any other options but pushing me to get it done there and just see if my cat was going to make it. I went here thinking they care about our pets but left feeling like I was just another dollar for them. If they cared they could have given me options but none were given but to pay and figure it out after Monday. At the end I just took my cat somewhere else yes more pricey but at least they gave me options and I actually saw the vet.

Ps. if your pet is hospitalized they don’t have nobody watching your pet at night when personnel isn’t there—-per their paperwork they make you read before getting treatment

Go to Gulf Coast.
This clinic charged close to 2k for an emergency spay. When I got my cat she was dead asleep in the carrier and when I carried her in the car I noticed her back legs were dead weight and I assumed it was from the anesthesia, later I come to realize she was actually paralyzed.
When I first came in the lady helping us was annoyed that I was asking her to remove some things from the bill like the plastic collar and idk what she took out bc the final bill still had items that she said would’ve been taken out.
Long story short, if it’s an emergency, take them to Gulf Coast, pricey but it’s worth it. I ultimately had to take my baby there and told me what was wrong and ultimately had to put her down. She was 3 years old

Money is their top priority over treatment.

I came home and found my Blue Healer coughing and choking because his saliva gland was swollen and blocking half his airway. I went to my dogs Vet and they offered me no support even if I waited 4 hours and 1700.00. I went to another emergency center Vet and they too only offered me to operate for 2000.00.  My mother told em about a center that helped my uncle's dogs and was fair price and they even offered me a payment plan and operated the same day for him. I put down 400.00 of a payment plan of 154 a month for the total of 1000.00. They even made me feel like they actually cared enough to offer me options instead of turning me away. Thank you very much ladies of East End Animal Surgery..... 🤗
Thank you so much! Excellent care for our pet family member when he was experiencing an emergency. All the staff were so kind and explained everything really well.
Thank you for taking the time to leave a positive review.

I am so grateful to this clinic. My dog ​​is 10 years old and wasn't in good condition. They did everything possible to help him recover, and thanks to them, he's much better. I love that they have payment plans, good medications, and above all, the patience and honesty they always demonstrate. Thank you so much.
Definitely recommend.

They saved my cats life. She was a stray I had found on the street and had an infection on top of her head and after being offered at another vet a $1,000+ for testing(money I didn’t have at the the time), they offered to put her down for free if I had no alternative…I came here and after testing and medications, it came out to ≈$200. I will always be grateful to them!
Saved my cats life after I went to 3 other vet places and we’re going to charge me thousands!! Prepare to wait in your car they are booked but will call you when your pet is ready!
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a positive review.

I loved the staff as well as the pricing. Initial exam, x-rays, and meds all came out to just over $400. Only reason I’m leaving a 2 star review is because I called them back after leaving requesting my dogs x rays as I need that to be able to contact orthopedic surgeons about getting my dog help and they told me I’d receive it by the end of the night. I have not received it and they are closed until Saturday. It is incredibly frustrating and honestly saddening that I either have to go somewhere and spend even more money to get everything done all over again or I have to wait for a week until Saturday to call and receive those. My dog has 2 broken legs and needs to see someone asap and now we can’t because I was never emailed the x-rays.

I took my deceased dog here because when I called they said that they provide cremation services (through a third party). I read a review about a woman who also took her deceased pet here and that the service included a paw imprint, an urn, and a name plate. They told my bf that it would take about two weeks to get the ashes back, so we waited for updates via text or email (which they said they would update). We called today since it’s almost been a month and it turns out that there was a “miscommunication” and now my dog’s ashes are not retrievable. I don’t even know what to do or say at this point. They gave us a refund, but it doesn’t really excuse not getting my doggie back.

Great experience. Our dogs ear got damaged and they took us in with in minutes and had a solution in less then an hour. My partner and I were treated with respect and rapidly. Took care of our Bella that day.
Dr. Gallegos is a wonderful vet who actually cares about animals! Highly recommend to any one looking for affordable care for their pets in need

There is not enough words to express my gratitude towards the Doctor who performed an emergency surgery that saved my dog’s life! The entire staff was WONDERFUL!  I cannot thank you enough! Thank you for your time and overall the care for my dog Leónidas! Thank you so much!

Took care of my fur-baby when he was diagnosed with parvo
Best service!

They took the time to try and explain why it was so expensive. Everyone was nice and kept our baby alive overnight but we still had to seek help elsewhere. They are only open a few days a week. They did not let us see the back where the animals are tested and treated. The Dr and staff were nice and seemed to care about their patients but our dog really needed another night on fluids so we had to find another vet that was open during the week.
They saved Louie's life ... he had bloat and they did the surgery for 1/3 of the cost others quoted us.  They even told us about finance options.

We were in and a out in 5 minutes charged $75. Im reporting them to BBB, the only reason we went because it was a Sunday. Emergency care, emergency rip-off. These people are the worse. I went in with my cats, which was attacked. They wanted to charge $1,400. $400 of that was just in case he needed more meds. It's ridiculous how they.  are in business. Im disgusted how they can just charge such an outrageous price. These type of business should really be looked at. My cat died. Because yall didn't want to preform any services but was quick to take $75. Vergi emergency on Voss was willing to do cpr.  You guys are horrible and should be put out of business. This is my mission

Unsung heroes of the veterinary world.

At a different practice, we were quoted $7k for a bowel obstruction surgery after we already paid $600 for x-rays (no shade to this other practice, we simply couldn’t afford additional services). They mentioned East End clinic by name as a low cost option, and we made it there right before they closed for the rest of the week. I believe we were the last patient of the day, but the team still allowed us the time we needed to ask questions, discuss payment options, and prepare for taking our dog home post-op. He was alert and well following his surgery, and he’s been doing great so far. They showed us what was obstructing (a bread clip), and explained that it probably got stuck because of a previous surgery at the site the clip was). They don’t keep animals overnight as they close at midnight, so if you get there late, be prepared to either have to take your dog somewhere else or monitor them yourself (as we did). But when your options are getting that surgery or letting your pet die, this place allows you the fighting chance to keep them alive when you can’t afford somewhere else. Very grateful to this team and their mission.
They saved my dog after the neighbors dog got her.
Thank you for the kind review. We’re glad you felt the care was both helpful and reasonably priced, and we appreciate you taking the time to share your experience.
This place is amazing! The prices are cheaper!my dog loves it here! Only thing he doesn't like is getting his weight taken! Oh and obviously get this temp took lol

I had a horrible experience leaving my cat Pretzel to be hospitalized at this place. I had high expectations that he would be cared for by the staff that "care" for the animals, only to discover within a three day span later that he was getting in critical condition. Not just that, but he was also in a state of unhygienic, that the staff didn't bother to clean him until he was discharged. To even be offered for him to be kept an extra week, even for free, would mean he would be left alone just to "make sure" he got his IV fluids but nothing else such as even trying to keep him alive. I don't feel they tried hard enough, only just to charge for the days he stayed there. To even be suggested to transfer him to another clinic seems they didn't even want to try at all.

In the end, I took him home because I'd rather keep him in his last moments than to leave him in a place where it didn't even seem they cared to at least keep him clean, and he sadly passed away mere moments later the same night. I didn't even get a chance to talk the doctor, who I feel should've come and talk regardless of how many other patients they might be dealing with. It is also a duty for the vet to at least speak with those bringing in their pets and not just leave the duty to the staff like the technicians.

No explanation or excuse they will give me via review reply will bring my cat back. It's better to take your pets somewhere else where the vet is willing to talk with their patients, and has more clear communication within their staff members.
Very compassionate! I totally appreciate the treatment I received.

I'll be very straightforward. I recently went to this urgent care due to a concerning matter regarding my pet who was being suddenly very lethargic. I went in hoping to get some help at a decent price. First red flag that i noticed was that i never once spoke to the veterinarian of the establishment.  I spoke to 3 different vet techs regarding what was the matter with my dog all in which were passing information to the veterinarian. It was more like a "he said she said" without actually talking to the veterinarian once and getting their reassurance. Eventually after explaining what was wrong, they come back with a quote in the upper $900 for xrays and bloodwork not considering treatment.  I understand urgent cares are for sudden emergencies but its not reasuring when i get asked 3 times whats wrong , not talk to a vet directly and then get greeted with a $900+ quote. Another thing is the fact that my dog was muzzled when she was clearly very weak as she was very dehydrated and lethargic as mentioned and it broke my heart to see it as she was clearly scared out of her mind walking out as sick as she was. She was given a shot for the day as i decided to wait and take her to her usual vet in the morning. One last thing, chewing and popping bubble gum while with a patient is not appropriate especially with repetitive popping sounds. Not very professional. I wish i had a better experience.

My dog got sick this morning 1-04-2026 and my primary doctor can’t do the emergency surgery so he send me to a emergency hospital in sugarland and they want me to pay $9,000 dollars for spayed which she had an infection very bad, and I found this place and they did everything to cure my dog for $1,300 …. I’m so thankful for this place…  they are very friendly, professional, clean place …

I brought my senior dog in for urgent care because I suspected an ear infection. I called several vet urgent care in the Houston area and they were priced most reasonably at $80 or so. I was appreciative of this & that they’re open on Sundays as our regular vet isn’t open on weekends. The staff was friendly and helpful, and I appreciated that we were one of the first two clients when they opened. He was examined and given ear cleaner and pain medication. However, despite arriving early, the visit took nearly three hours.

What was most upsetting was what I discovered once we got home. After removing my dog’s harness and leash, I found smeared feces inside the harness and across his chest. It was extremely unhygienic and shocking. I have no way of knowing how or when this happened, but it clearly went unnoticed and unaddressed before my dog was returned to me.

While accidents can happen, the fact that my dog was sent home in this condition shows a lack of basic attention to cleanliness and care. That discovery overshadowed any positives from the visit and left me questioning the level of care being provided, especially for vulnerable senior pets.

Because of this experience, I would not recommend this clinic.
Very friendly staff and excellent service, they give us complete information on how the process is going and the condition of our pets.

This is hands down the best urgent care animal clinic EVER! DR. Gallegos our Vet a tech Leslie and Natalya in the front are on there game. I will call them the A-Team. Stop in and let them make your day the same way they made ours.

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We're glad your visit went well and appreciate you choosing us for your pet's care. We hope you won't need us again anytime soon, but if an emergency arises, we're here to help.

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We're glad your visit went well and appreciate you choosing us for your pet's care. We hope you won't need us again anytime soon, but if an emergency comes up, we're here to help.

I’m so glad I stumbled upon this clinic. Obviously, it’s not good that I needed an urgent care but their prices are reasonable, they were pretty quick despite being busy. I love the upfront and transparency with treatment and cost. I definitely will be keeping their number saved for any future emergencies that may arise.

I'm REALLY glad others had a better experience than I did a East End Animal.  I took my morkie in on November 14th with bloody diarrhea and excessive gas for 2 days. Upon arrival they took my dog to the back and placed me in a room.  After 30 minutes a young assistant comes in to ask me questions.  I presented her with photos and conveyed my concerns.

She leaves the room and comes back 15-20 mins later with an estimate of nearly $600 for labs and a shot for dehydration. I accept the the estimate with the expectation the Vet who hadn't bothered coming in the room at this point to discuss ANYTHING... Or ask me one question.  I made the assumption that she at least had a good understanding of what was going on with my Honee. (She remained in the back with them during the entire visit).

35 mins later the Vet emerges to tell me their going to give me a can of food for her... Give that to her and then transition her back to her food.  I ask... Is it possible the food is the problem?  She said "she should be fine after the can"... She probably just ate something she shouldn't have.

1.5 weeks later... She's once again exhibiting chronic gas, she's lethargic and has excessive diarrhea again.  I called to ask if they had a recommendation, or if they could call in something for her... I was told I could bring her in for "another evaluation".  When I asked what that would look like THIS TIME... I was told, we could do some labs and see what's going on?  Hmmmmm.... Like the $350 worth of labs, that got me a can of food and a good luck!

My baby is MISERABLE and clearly MORE LABS aren't the way to find out what's going on with her.  If you take your beloved pet here for an Urgent Care visit like I did... Don't leave without a DIAGNOSIS and a plan of action, in the event the labs tell you nothing and the issues persist.

I brought Monkey on Sept after he ate some hairties. I had been referred from another location and the ladies at East End went above and beyond for the little guy. I came back again recently over some concerns and, again, they provided excellent care and service. I can guarantee that your babies will be safe and given the utmost care by all the lovely ladies in this location.

Thank you, thank you, so much for everything you ladies do. Y'all are truly a gift. Thank you, thank you.
Came in expecting surgery  but am leaving with a non-surgical treatment for a lower price.   Everyone is so nice.  100% recommend.

I brought my dog, Alex, to this clinic after he was attacked by two dogs and had multiple puncture wounds on his neck. I specifically pointed out a serious wound near his jugular to their technician and was assured it would be taken care of. I was charged over $800 and left Alex in their care, but the experience that followed was unacceptable.

I received no updates for hours after leaving him, despite the seriousness of his condition. I had to call myself to find out if he was even okay.
When I picked him up, the wound I had specifically pointed out was not shaved, not sutured, and not properly treated. Only after I questioned it did they shave the area, but they still left it open, saying it needed to “drain.” This was the exact wound I brought him in for.
Staff members Jackie and Leslie and Natalie were extremely rude and unprofessional, refusing to help me carry my injured dog to the car (despite knowing I had an injured shoulder) and even yelling at me outside the clinic.
I was given no receipt, no clear aftercare instructions, and no explanation about his medications. When I asked for clarification, I was brushed off and told there was no manager available to speak with me.
The only person who showed any professionalism was the receptionist. Otherwise, the staff was dismissive, unhelpful, and disrespectful. Most importantly, my dog’s most critical wound—the one I specifically pointed out—was not properly treated.

For over $800, I expected competent medical care and basic courtesy. Instead, I left with an untreated wound, no guidance on aftercare, and a very negative experience. I cannot recommend this clinic and strongly urge other pet owners to consider this before bringing their animals here.

I cannot thank Dr. Gallegos and her team enough for the care and compassion they showed my cat, Eggroll. At 15 years old, she had been struggling with her health, and sadly it was time to say goodbye. The staff was incredibly kind and understanding throughout the entire process. They treated Eggroll with so much love and respect, and made sure she was comfortable and cared for until the very end.

Even in such a difficult moment, I felt supported and reassured knowing that she was in the best hands. Dr. Gallegos explained everything with patience and compassion, which brought me peace during an emotional time. The private cremation service was also handled with the utmost respect, and I was grateful that it was both affordable and done with such dignity.

This clinic truly goes above and beyond for their patients and their families, and I will always be grateful for the way they cared for Eggroll and helped me through this loss.

I’m so sorry I couldn’t express my gratitude in person. You all are amazing and I’ll forever remember the kindness you showed my precious Eggroll in her final moments. Thank you.

They saved out cat’s life!  Our cat had an obstructed bowel, and the first place we took her to was up to 10 thousand dollars to perform the life saving surgery!  We couldn’t afford it, and were going to have to euthanize her, but they recommended trying this place first.  Was able to get her in the same day at a price we could afford, and she is doing well now!
They where closed an hour early before closing time. I recommend you call before going there.
Great, friendly staff, very knowledgeable. And they’re open late which helps for late night emergencies.

They have good hours for emergencies.  They can work with you with payments depending on the cost. They are very nice and have helped two of my animals get better. Also cheaper than some other emergency pet rooms.

The staff here were so understanding and so helpful with my cat, they help work with payment plans if needed and they all looked after my baby like their own.
Absolutely will go again for any future emergencies or general checks

I am so grateful to the doctor and all the staff. They saved my little pug. He had surgery, and they allowed me to pay in installments.

Thank you ❤
They save my beauty Kala ! A car hit my dog and they put back her leg ! Amazing people thank you thank you !

Thank you to the receptionist of an emergency vent in Pearland that refered me to VUC!!! Right off the bat she told me that they were going to charge an arm and a leg for what I thought Lady had (pyometra).

I called VUC and they told me to come in asap because they close at 12, and depending on the severity of Lady's case they can do the surgery the same night. We rushed in from Rosharon and got there by cutoff time.
The place was clean and smelled good. There was 2 other pets there, one was being seen and the other was going home. I was listening to one nurse give home care instructions and it sounded like she loved what she does and cared about the pet!
The nurse was so caring and just READY TO HELP!
She took Lady straight in for a check up. Came back and confirmed it was pyometra and had all the answers and quotes ready to go. She went through everythingthat was going to happen, and what all was included in the quote and gave me the price. My jaw dropped.  Without hesitation I agreed and they went to work right away.
We were out of there within 2 hours and Lady is recovering and I will forever be grateful!! I will be recommending VUC to anyone!
I did not get the chance to thank Lady's Dr... so- THANK YOU!!!

The best bet there is! My Kitty needed surgery and they helped me, I couldn’t pay everything up front so they gave me a payment plan! I would have had to put my baby down if it wasn’t for them! Thank you guys so much for all of Y’alls help with Xena!!

We want to take the time to recommend this place  this is the second time our little chiwawa has surgery here whit doctor Gallego    We was nervous   But its normal we are a little over protective whit our dogs   We  found  the staff   Very helpful  and kind   And in  both surgeries  our dog recover perfectly they told Us what to spect And no no isues also had my female boxer   Fixed  here   Affordable prices and also they have a payment plan very thankful  to doctor and. Staff

We were so stressed out about our baby girl’s emergency surgery, but the staff at this place was incredibly professional and caring. Other places we’ve visited didn’t seem to care about the pets’ health; they just wanted our money and weren’t willing to work with us, even if we did not have all the funds. We’re so thankful we found this place, and she was able to have surgery the same day. They took so much care of her, and I can’t thank the entire staff enough. We’re truly blessed, and I’ll definitely refer others to this place.
Thank you for the review! We appreciate your support and are glad you had a positive experience with us.
